lines.text: A shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and the Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him.
He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
The wolf will live with the lamb, and a little child will lead them.
The LORD will split the Jordan into seven streams, and a highway will be there for the remnant from Assyria.
With joy they will draw water from the springs of salvation and make His works known among the Gentiles.
